  • Method Details

    • executeBuy

      Transaction executeBuy(User user, String symbol, int quantity) throws TradingException
      Executes an immediate market buy order for a designated stock ticker.
      Parameters:
      user - the account holder initiating the acquisition
      symbol - the ticker identifier of the target equity
      quantity - the number of shares to purchase
      Returns:
      the finalized transaction ledger record
      Throws:
      TradingException - if validation fails, stock does not exist, or funds are insufficient

    • executeSell

      Transaction executeSell(User user, String symbol, int quantity) throws TradingException
      Executes an immediate market sell order for a designated stock ticker.
      Parameters:
      user - the account holder initiating the sale
      symbol - the ticker identifier of the target equity
      quantity - the number of shares to liquidate
      Returns:
      the finalized transaction ledger record
      Throws:
      TradingException - if validation fails, stock does not exist, or shares are insufficient

    • getMarket

      Market getMarket()
      Retrieves the market engine associated with this trading service.
      Returns:
      the active Market instance
